functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_room_by_code(lookup_code character varying)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, code character varying, status public.room_status, participant_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT r.id, r.code, r.status, r.participant_count
  FROM public.rooms r
  WHERE r.code = lookup_code
    AND r.status = 'LOBBY';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_current_user_room_participant(target_room_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.room_participants
    WHERE room_id = target_room_id
      AND participant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'sub')::uuid
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_vote_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'VOTE_IMMUTABLE: votes are immutable once recorded'
    USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$

policies.qual:
CASE
    WHEN (realtime.topic() ~~ 'room:%'::text) THEN ((realtime.topic() = ('room:'::text || (auth.jwt() ->> 'room_id'::text))) AND public.is_current_user_room_participant(((auth.jwt() ->> 'room_id'::text))::uuid))
    ELSE true
END

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_rooms_retention_delete BEFORE DELETE ON public.rooms FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.enforce_room_retention()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_votes_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON public.votes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_vote_delete_except_room_purge()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_votes_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON public.votes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_vote_mutation()
